note: Taking the back from the mount or side control, as the man underneath turns away to escape (the roll in footage 6765428, 7.5 to 9.5 s). top: the man taking the back, who ends underneath with the man lying back on him; bot: the man whose back is taken. He turns onto his side, away; the man on top rides him, chest on his back, hands into the seatbelt, slides down behind him onto a hip, puts a hook in, and rolls back onto his back taking him along, turning half round as he goes.

keys.note: he turns away onto his side (turned about his spine: the pelvis's yaw; its roll would swing him round flat on the mat), the knees falling together to that side; ridden, chest on his back
off the top onto one hip beside him, sat on it with both legs folded to that side (a side-sit: one out to each side, tilted like this, would be the splits)

down behind him on a hip, the seatbelt on, a hook going in; he's on his side. His feet come round with the hips: keyed once at 350 and left while the pelvis went on turning, the foot stopped matching the shin and the ankle read as twisted a whole 2 rad
the roll back, taking him over onto his chest (he turns from his side onto his back on top of him: about his spine, the yaw, not swung round on the mat)

deny.note: stopped as he turns away: he turns back square under him (the yaw back), elbows tight to his sides, and the man on top settles back where he was

revNote: caught as the man on top shifts his weight to follow the turn: the bridge throws him over the shoulder
